title: Structured Reporting
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Start from the clinical question in the request, because that is what the report has to answer.
State the technique: the sequences acquired, the planes, and anything that limited them.
Record the relevant negatives, since a question is answered only when the alternative has been excluded.
Report words have no shared definition between departments.
